title: Hanford's February regulator meeting records nineteen vitrified-waste containers sent to IDF
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Hanford Field Office and Washington State Department of Ecology
summary: The February 12, 2026 Hanford project-manager meeting minutes report that a total of 19 vitrified-waste containers had been sent to the Integrated Disposal Facility. Denominator: The cumulative vitrified-container shipment-to-IDF count reported at the February meeting, kept separate from fill, quality release, receipt, acceptance, staging, and disposal.
